text:
Amelia: Just got back from a tiny weekend farm — met this baby alpaca named Mochi. He followed me like a puppy 🦙❤️ pic: https://i.imgur.com/AlpacaMochi.jpg
Raj: no way. that face. absolute soft royalty. :heart_eyes:
Tom: omg the fluff. did you try to feed it carrots?
Amelia: Yes! He politely accepted one and then judged my life choices. 100% behaved.
Kiki: Can we make Mochi the official company mascot? I will design a cape. 🦙✨
Raj: vote: adopt Mochi as mascot? 1) yes 2) yes with cape 3) yes and merch pls
Tom: 2, obviously. put him on a mug.
GIPHY: :partyparrot: (animation)
Amelia: low-key considering renaming my Slack emoji set to Mochi-only.
Kiki: request: more pictures or the thread does not pass the Cute Standard Audit.
Amelia: uploaded another: https://files.redwood.ai/members/amelia/mochi_nap.jpg
Raj: 10/10 would cuddle. also can we have a mandatory alpaca day in the office?
Tom: depends. alpaca in office = instant productivity spike or instant hay allergy test.
Kiki: I'd accept either outcome. also who wants to join a weekend trip to the farm next month? small group.
Amelia: tagging with the shortlist: @Raj @Kiki @Tom — totally optional but Mochi approves. :thumbsup:
Raj: sold. adding to calendar now.
Tom: I will bring snacks. Mochi's rating of snacks will be the new benchmark for all vendor deals.
Amelia: closing note: Mochi snores like a tiny lawnmower. goodnight. :zzz:
